propositions: A parent removed in Jira is never emitted as an inbound clear because fetcher.py omits absent parents from snapshots and inbound_differ.py refuses parent_id=None, leaving local parent_id fields permanently out of sync
The fetcher's parent enrichment deliberately leaves the parent field absent when mapped parent is None, collapsing 'Jira has no parent' and 'parent key not yet bound' into one unobservable state
The differ's _extract_parent_local_id returns None for three distinct situations but the differ skips all of them, including the observed-absent case where a clear should fire

Without positive evidence that the peer once carried a parent, clearing on managed_refs alone deletes local parent edges that rebar never pushed, as demonstrated by the 63-ticket incident on Cloud production

The inbound parent clear requires arbitration on ADR-0026 peer baseline: clearing only when get_peer_parent returns truthy AND this pass observed no parent prevents spurious clears on truncated reads or degraded parent-map responses
